_about: Evaluation questions used to tune each collection and the router. 'answerable' questions list a keyword that must appear in the top chunk. 'broad' questions list several keywords that must all appear in the top-3 chunks. 'near_topic' questions belong to the document's subject but are not answered by it. 'unrelated' questions match no document.

answerable: Where does Liverpool play its home matches?
Who managed Manchester United from 1986 to 2013?
Which fans sing You'll Never Walk Alone?
Which club shares the San Siro with Inter?
broad: How many Saudi clubs are mentioned?
near_topic: How many players are on a football team?
